host: Logic Pro 12.3 (6674) on macOS 26.6, UI language en, fixture lpm-locale-campaign
how: Scripts/livekit/ax_key_command_census.swift — opens Logic Pro > Key Commands > Edit Assignments… by menu TITLE (no coordinates), reads the command name of every row in the assignment table, looks up four commands that certainly exist as controls, filters for a name that would move a track, and closes the window again. Nothing is typed into the search field and no assignment is changed.

controls.note: All four must be present, or a census that found no track-move command found nothing for the wrong reason.

sort_tracks_is_absent_and_that_is_correc: `Sort Tracks by` is a submenu PARENT in the Track menu rather than a command, and it does not appear in the assignment list. It was tried as a control first and dropped for that reason — its absence is a fact about the list, not a failure of the probe.
